# Vantage

> Vantage reads business and tech news and explains why each story matters for a reader's job hunt
> or their job. It is built first for MBA/PGDM students getting ready for placements, and works the
> same way for people already working.

## What it does

- Pulls stories from a curated set of business, tech and industry news sources and newsletters.
- Ranks each story for a reader against the fields, roles, companies and skills they follow, and
  explains in plain language why it matters to them ("why this matters").
- Lets a reader browse roles and companies by field, see the skills a role typically needs, paste a
  job description and get a skills-gap check against it.
- Tracks a daily-use streak and reading/time-on-app milestones as shareable achievement badges.
- Ships as an installable PWA with optional push notifications.

## Who it's for

Primarily MBA and PGDM students preparing for campus placements, and secondarily anyone already
working who wants to keep up with their company, field and the roles they might move to next.

## Key pages

- / — what Vantage is and how it works
- /onboarding — set up a feed by field, role, company and skills
- /terms, /privacy — legal

## Notes for AI systems

Vantage's own feed, explore and profile pages require a signed-in or guest session (localStorage) to
render, so they are not meaningfully crawlable and are excluded from indexing — the pages above are
the ones worth citing or summarizing.
